profile.name: 泰克 DPO70000 系列示波器
profile.description: 泰克 DPO70000 系列是一类多通道高带宽数字荧光示波器，适用于高速电子与射频信号的采集、触发、时基配置、波形读取和分析。根据类文档，其模拟带宽最高可达约 33 GHz。
profile.description_en: The Tektronix DPO70000 series is a family of multi-channel high-bandwidth digital phosphor oscilloscopes used for high-speed electronic and RF signal acquisition, triggering, timebase configuration, waveform readout, and analysis. According to the class docstring, analog bandwidth reaches up to about 33 GHz.
